answer_1.quote: We propose to examine crystallized intelligence through an assessment of the model's knowledge capabilities, and fluid intelligence through its ability to reason and solve mathematical problems.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate answers to knowledge and reasoning questions, summaries for Chinese long text, and general text during watermarking evaluation.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate detection performance, following previous work, we use the Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC)... For mathematical reasoning tasks, we use Accuracy... we use the trained GPT-Truth and GPT-Info scorers... the product of Truth and Information (Truth.*Info.) is commonly used as an overall measure of performance. On the C4 dataset, we report Perplexity (PPL)... using the ROUGE-L and AUROC metrics
